name: My Fluffy Herbivore High
source:
While hiding from a bully, you stumble upon a strange glowing seed that transports you to a world inhabited by herbivores and carnivores.

Suddenly, human troubles feel distant as you struggle to survive in a land filled with constant danger, all while searching for a way back home.

With the help of your herbivore friends, the journey seems manageable—but in this world, predators lurk around every corner…

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.soushoku]Google Play[/url]]
